details.eligibility: Graduation with minimum 60% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwBD) from a recognised university, as per the RBI Grade B notification on rbi.org.in.
details.pattern: Phase I: 200 marks objective (General Awareness 80, English 30, Quant 30, Reasoning 60), 120 minutes. Phase II: 3 papers — Economic & Social Issues, Finance & Management, English (descriptive). Then Interview (75 marks).
details.syllabus: Economy & Social Issues, Finance & Management, English Language (incl. descriptive writing), General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning.
